correctness.rationale: Exact multiplication weights give a diagonal positive D with twofold eigenvalues; the algebraic difference and n↔1-n reflection were reconstructed. Finite telescoping proves trace 1-q. Strict ratio yields maximal eigenvalue. With h=-log q, dominated Riemann sums (geometric upper bound e^(-k h)) prove every fixed-p moment and each fixed-t Fredholm logarithm; beta integration and the explicit t derivative yield B(p,p) and arcosh²(1+t/2). Strict monotone logistic profile gives exact level counts. Exact-rational checker passes 137 claims; no finite check is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The nonnormality of the canonical annular coordinate multiplier is an intrinsic spectral object. As the two boundary circles coalesce, D tends to zero but develops a diverging number of natural size-(1-q)^2 eigenvalues. The explicit arcosh-square logarithmic determinant, all-p Beta moments and level-count law jointly quantify this transition, beyond the elementary trace or an arbitrary finite special case. This is a motivated full-parameter asymptotic, with an exact count profile and plausible applications to thin-annulus operator perturbations.
